name: Minimum Justification Rigor
description: Business justification must contain at least 15 characters articulating operational requirement.

name: Lateral Transfer Grade Consistency
description: Lateral Transfer target position grade must strictly match current grade.

name: Promotion Grade Ascension
description: Promotion target grade must be strictly higher than current employee grade.

name: Budgetary Authorization Enforcement
description: New Position creation and Promotions strictly require verified budget approval (has_budget_approval = true).

name: Valid Emirates Group Employee Identification
description: Transfers and promotions strictly require a valid, active employee ID (e.g., EK-XXXXX).

name: Executive Grade Leap Governance
description: Promotions exceeding 2 grade bands require Senior VP Human Resources endorsement and additional justification.
